takes.title: Walk Forward with Relaxed Arm Swings
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step and walks forward with relaxed, alternating arm swings through the last frame.

takes.title: Swing with Arms Overhead and Step Away
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with both arms raised, repeatedly bends the knees and swings the legs forward, then drops into bent knees and steps away. The CMU source identifies a playground bar.

takes.title: Step into an Overhead Swing and Land
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes a wide entry step, lifts both hands overhead, and alternates tucked knees and forward leg swings. They finish in a bent-knee landing stance.
